frontier.hypothesis: The instrumented allocno-priority dump (BB2_ALLOC_DEBUG / BB2_PRIO_DEBUG tmp/gccdbg/cc1 per memory/project/register-alloc-deep-dive.md) will show the priority computation at 0xC4 and either name the exact tiebreaker input to attack, or confirm this is the global.c:624 cpu_side_move_dir_4-class wall.
frontier.mechanism: Global RA (global.c) assigns hard regs to pseudos in priority order; when two candidate hard regs are eligible for one pseudo, a tiebreaker (reg-alloc-order or reg_n_refs cost) decides. The dump surfaces the exact priority and conflict-list for pseudo 104 at its birth, and the free-reg-list state, letting us either (a) find the C-side lever that shifts the tiebreaker, or (b) prove parity-with-cpu_side_move_dir_4 class.
